reuse.why: Threads the flag into the existing shared isWrittenByMonthAction predicate that every month-wide action already calls, rather than filtering anywhere else.

duplication.why: The hidden rule is changed once in the predicate; the actions only forward the flag.

placement.why: The variation lives in the predicate in budget/actions.ts that the tree uses to decide which categories month-wide actions write.

scope.why: Only the predicate, the action signatures and two tests change; the group_hidden type widening supports the reworked 'average' branch.

maintainability.why: One place to own the rule; a fourth positional argument (two of them booleans) at six call sites is a bit unwieldy compared with an options object.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions keep calling isWrittenByMonthAction.
